1	/**
2	 * Side-effect-free predicate shared by the fail-on-console setup. Returns true
3	 * when an unexpected `console.error` / `console.warn` message is KNOWN
4	 * INFRASTRUCTURE NOISE that must not fail a test — as opposed to a real signal
5	 * of a code defect. Keep this list short and exact; broadening it weakens the
6	 * guard for every test in the monorepo.
7	 *
8	 * `msg` is the fully-interpolated message (`util.format(firstArg, ...rest)`),
9	 * so a substring match catches the error text even when it is a trailing
10	 * console argument (e.g. `console.error('[x] failed:', err.message)`).
11	 *
12	 * Kept in its own module (no top-level `failOnConsole(...)` side effect) so the
13	 * contract can be unit-tested without registering the global console hooks.
14	 */
15	export function isSilencedConsoleMessage(msg: unknown): boolean {
16	  if (typeof msg !== 'string') return false;
17	  // React 19 hydration noise from third-party libs (Monaco, etc.).
18	  if (msg.includes('was not wrapped in act(...)')) return true;
19	  // PostgreSQL connection-pool EXHAUSTION (SQLSTATE 53300). On the shared dev
20	  // box the suite's forked workers contend for the same native PG with the
21	  // live + staging operators and the rest of the fleet; under load PG runs out
22	  // of connection slots and the best-effort graceful-degradation paths (wire-
23	  // outbox backfill, outbox-drain, route-telemetry, adv-sessions, cross-hive
24	  // ledger) log these. They are SERVER resource-limit messages, never a code
25	  // defect, and the code that emits them already catches+continues — so they
26	  // are box weather, not a signal. Silencing only these two exact strings keeps
27	  // the gate measuring correctness (a real connection-leak regression still
28	  // fails on the asserted query path / a thrown error, not on an incidental log
29	  // line) while removing a recurring full-suite-only flake's grip on the hourly
30	  // green-checkpoint. Same philosophy as the unit-timeout headroom in
31	  // vitest-config.ts ("runner robustness, not test weakening").
32	  if (msg.includes('connection slots are reserved')) return true;
33	  if (msg.includes('too many clients already')) return true;
34	  return false;
35	}
